title: Scope
text: This simplified policy covers online and in-store purchases in Canada. It was written for the Perfect Pair prototype and is not ALDO's published policy.

title: Return window
text: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery (online) or purchase (in store).

title: Loyalty extension
text: Gold members get 15 extra days, for 45 days in total.

title: Final sale
text: Items marked final sale cannot be returned or exchanged, unless they are defective or arrived damaged.

title: Condition
text: Items must be unworn, with the original packaging. Only a person may refuse a worn item, and only after looking at the evidence. Defective items are always accepted.

title: Refunds
text: Refunds go to the original payment method. Gift purchases are refunded as store credit. Refunds are issued when the item is received, or at the drop-off scan for Gold and Silver members whose return rate is 20% or less.

title: Return fee
text: Change-of-mind returns by mail pay a $5.95 label fee. Returns dropped off in a store are free.

title: Fee waivers
text: No fee is charged when the return was caused by ALDO (wrong item sent, or product information that misled the customer), by the carrier (late delivery or damage in transit), or by a defect. Exchanges and Smart Credit are always free to return.

title: Product information fault
text: Fit counts as ALDO's product-information fault when at least 20% of reviews (and at least 10 reviews) report the same fit issue and the product page did not warn about it.

title: Exchanges
text: Online exchanges are allowed for a different size, width or colour (proposed by Perfect Pair). A price difference is refunded or charged.

title: Exchange delivery promise
text: The new pair must be able to reach the customer within 5 business days. It ships from any store or the distribution centre.

title: Smart Credit
text: Store credit for the full value, which never expires, plus discounts on picks chosen for the customer. Discounts are never deeper than the planned markdown and never below the item's recovery value. An optional in-store bonus of 10%, up to $25, is valid for 30 days. Picks can be held in a nearby store for 48 hours.

title: When Smart Credit is offered
text: Not for damaged, defective or late orders, not when the customer is upset, and not when items bought with earlier credit came back. At least two picks must pass all three tests: the customer would want it, ALDO needs to move it, it won't come back.

title: Keep-it refund
text: A refund without the return when the label and processing cost more than the item's recovery value, the item is under $40, the customer's return rate is at or below the category average, and they have had no keep-it refund in the past 12 months.

title: Financial authority
text: The agent may approve refunds, credits and exchanges up to $250 per return. From $250 to $500 a store associate or customer-service lead approves. Over $500, or when abuse is suspected, a supervisor approves.

title: No automated denials
text: The agent never refuses a return on suspicion or judgment. Unclear high-value cases and suspected abuse go to a person with the evidence. When the policy itself rules a return out (outside the window, or final sale), the agent explains the clause and offers a review by a person.

title: Product page changes
text: A merchandiser approves every change to a product page before it is published.

title: Explanations
text: Every decision cites the data rows and the policy clauses it relies on.

title: Privacy
text: Agents work with customer IDs. Names, email addresses, phone numbers and street addresses are never shown to the agent or written into messages.
